_doc: Per-fixture DOT node-size ratchet for the description DOT-parity suite (mission S1L). Same convention as oracle/goldens/state|object/size-backlog.json: structurally EQUAL fixtures whose maxSizeDeltaIn (inches, max across their svek-N graphs) exceeds the 0.01in conformant bar; the test asserts delta <= pinned + 1e-6 per fixture, so pins only shrink. A sub-mission that makes a fixture conformant drops its delta to <=0.01 and DELETES the entry (absent slug => conformant required). Re-baselined 2026-07-27 after S1L-b (description [ ... ] display-body expansion) from scripts/measure-description-size-deltas.ts. 115 entries / 351 goldens => 236 (67.2%) conformant. S1L-b flipped dexigu-24/kenece-24/zifaji-87 (the HR-body trio) plus butebe-90/zavitu-69 to conformant (deleted). fariba-82 is pinned 1.024479: S1L-b T6 diagnosed it as a compound residual (out-of-scope awslib sprite + a jar `file`-body word-wrap gap, S1L-d), NOT a leaf-width bug -- see plans/s1l-leaf-sizing/ledger.md. zotiru-33 shrank 2.655 -> 0.914 (S1L-b T5 wired scoped `<style> package { MinimumWidth }`; the `not_nested` package is now exact at 4.583in, residual is the nested package cluster (S1L-e) + an unclosed-`<color>` note tag). Root-cause families + sub-mission routing are in plans/s1l-leaf-sizing/ledger.md. The 2 latex fixtures are a permanent inherent-tolerance DIVERGENCE (KaTeX != JLaTeXMath, see DIVERGENCES.md), excluded from the conformant denominator but still pinned here shrink-only. S1L-b-unicode (2026-07-27) landed the codepoint decode-ordering fix (<U+..>/&#..; decode per-line at measure time, AFTER the newline split): heights no longer over-split, so gafico-37 shrank 5.680208->3.752777 and nujito-06 3.350521->3.122049 (shrink-only). Still 236/351 (67.2%) conformant -- the 3 targets remain named width residuals, NOT emoji-width bugs: gafico-37 + nujito-06 are driven by the UNPORTED <code> creole block (node c, deferred E2r L2; tracked GH #24); lurupu-11 (2.045912, unchanged) by a sizer<->renderer creole-lexer divergence (parseCreole leaves unclosed <b>/<font Name> literal, buildStripeAtoms strips them). See ledger.md S1L-b-unicode T1/T2/T3. creole-lexer-unification (2026-07-27) unified the sizer+renderer creole lexers onto one shared StripeSimple.buildLineAtoms helper (sizer dropped parseCreole), and — scope-expanded — ported AtomImg's URL cannot-decode text faithfully (creole-atoms.ts cannotDecodeText: http/https raster -> '(Cannot decode: <url>)', .svg url -> '(Cannot decode SVG: <url>)') and fixed a pre-existing description-parser leak of the '[body] as alias' wrapper into node.display for the keyword+bracket form (component-table-containers KEYWORD_RE -> parseBracketDeclaration). Net: lurupu-11 (2.045912->conformant, the original target), pebace-74 (0.172570->conformant, bracket+URL), zotiru-33 (0.914108->conformant) DELETED; nobiza-91 1.460330->0.669271, tuliba-37 6.735899->0.521007, gevozu-46/sunuju-01 4.670->0.611632, vivido-49 2.519868->0.157407, jecici-56 3.182521->0.315278, xufexu-38 1.457690->0.152778, nenedo-78 0.864816->0.168803 all shrank (zero widened). gafico-37/nujito-06 stay pinned unchanged: the T1 spike DISPROVED the brief's premise that the lexer switch would shrink them (their <color>/<u> tags sit adjacent to a decoded <U+000A> where both lexers agree); their residual is the deferred node-c <code> block. Remaining nobiza-91 0.669271 residual = note cannot-decode text measured at NOTE font 13 vs the jar's 14 (separate pre-existing gap; tracked GH #23). Now 112 entries / 351 => 239 (68.1%) conformant.
